name: j-delivery
description: JetThoughts autonomous delivery contract: the DISCOVER-to-LEARN loop with 4-eyes at every stage (author never verifies own work), evidence standard, WIP=1, the Kanban board flow (six lists, pull right-to-left, WIP limits, split at the time box), async-first artifacts - plus the /deliver kickoff command and the core author/verifier agent roster. Repo instructions always override the plugin on conflict.
